messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
If the JCB JS190NLC mobile crane at position 18 were used under regular conditions, i.e. outside the construction, steel, port and extractive sectors, how often would it have to be verified?

response.text: Se la gru mobile JCB JS190NLC in posizione 18 fosse utilizzata in condizioni ordinarie, cioè al di fuori dei settori edile, siderurgico, portuale ed estrattivo, con quale frequenza dovrebbe essere sottoposta a verifica?
